quizGuardRationale: Author hypotheses, not reviewer conclusions: use actual labels and ordinary meanings, with symmetric nontransitive protection. No production draw was reproduced.
水蒸気 safeguards steam/vapor and broad gas labels 蒸気/気体/ガス. 水素 has no gas-category guard merely because hydrogen can be gaseous.
垂直/縦 safeguards ordinary vertical wording; 水平 safeguards 横/平ら and English level ambiguity against 水準, without equating every orientation or standard.

推定 safeguards actual assumption/estimate/inference labels 仮定/予測/予想/見当/予算/判断/想像. These are context-dependent overlaps and label precautions, not future-only or numerical-only synonymy. 評判's public estimation concerns reputation and is not guarded by a substring match.
水筒/瓶 safeguards broad bottle wording without making every jar a drinking flask. 随筆/作文/文章 safeguards essay/writing labels; academic 論文 is a comparison rather than an asserted synonym.
水分 safeguards actual water/liquid/moisture/humidity labels 水/液体/湿気/湿度. Contained-water versus measurement and fluid-intake distinctions remain; 飲み物 is not excluded merely because people drink fluids.

水平線/線 safeguards broad line wording; 水平線/水平 is a conservative horizontal/horizontal-line English noun/adjective ambiguity precaution, not an inference from the shared component. Land/water horizon qualifiers remain on 地平線/水平線.
ずうずうしい/厚かましい directly overlaps in shamelessness. Shared speech situations alone do not establish an additional ずけずけ pair.

末っ子/子供 safeguards broad child/offspring wording; 幼い is not guarded because birth order does not establish youth. 図鑑/本 safeguards broad book wording; 杉/木 safeguards broad tree wording, not all botanical categories or a 杉/松 synonymy.

好き嫌い and 好き好き each safeguard 好み/趣味/好き and English taste ambiguity against 味; the two new nouns also have a direct pair. These do not make flavor a Japanese preference sense or derive exclusions transitively. 嫌い is not automatically guarded just because it is a component.

透き通る safeguards clear/pure/clear-voice labels 明らか/明確/はっきり/すっきり/さわやか/清い. Actual material and sound uses, rather than every clean or sunny topic, are considered; きれい/晴れる/晴れ/快晴 are not blanket exclusions.
スカーフ/水素 have no authored guards; absence is not independent approval. Reused metadata guards remain unchanged.
sourceAccessLimits: Seventeen new articles and three reuses cover N2:822-N2:841, a named community-list range, not an official modern syllabus.
Source-principal 20/27, packet source-plus-teaching 21/28 and comparison-union 191/402 are different accounting sets. The distinct 水曜日 identity does not replace or correct source 水曜.
Raw 水平 water level,horizon and 図鑑 picture book glosses remain verbatim but are qualified by applicable meanings. The raw ずうっと gloss stays blank; editorial anchors do not establish compiler intent.
水滴 gains only jlpt:2; 水曜日 remains unchanged at N5; ずっと preserves N3 metadata and gains only the source-alias paragraph. Unselected captured ずっと sense 4 is not newly taught.
Four new reciprocal N2 pairs: 蒸/水蒸気 at ジョウ, 筒/水筒 at トウ, 筆/随筆 at ヒツ, 線/水平線 at セン. Existing 滴/水滴 links remain intact. No kanji metadata, kanji cards or strokes are added.
Public extensions are not fabricated JMdict indices or independent JLPT assignments. Rare/search-only variants establish recognition, not usage frequency or naturalness.
The original pending-inspection plan remains unchanged. Public captures and completion receipts are author evidence, not reviewers' fresh retrievals.
No production quiz draws, exhaustive baseline rereview or native-speaker certification. The blind derivative omits only reviewEvidence.quizGuardRationale.
